prompt.name: Authoritative REU Validation
prompt.description: Research current NSF REU opportunities in AI and machine learning for undergraduates, identify the strongest currently relevant official opportunities, verify deadlines and eligibility from authoritative sources, and produce a concise actionable shortlist with uncertainty clearly labeled where needed.

task.name: Authoritative REU Validation
task.description: Research current NSF REU opportunities in AI and machine learning for undergraduates, identify the strongest currently relevant official opportunities, verify deadlines and eligibility from authoritative sources, and produce a concise actionable shortlist with uncertainty clearly labeled where needed.

research_plan.restated_task: Identify and validate current NSF REU opportunities in AI and machine learning for undergraduates for the 2025 academic year, producing a concise shortlist with verified deadlines and eligibility criteria, and clearly labeling any uncertainties.

subtasks.description: Discover relevant NSF REU programs in AI and machine learning for undergraduates.
subtasks.success_criteria: Collect a list of at least 10 distinct NSF REU programs offering AI or machine learning research opportunities for undergraduates, noting the institution hosting the REU.

subtasks.description: Verify Program Details – Deadlines and Eligibility
subtasks.success_criteria: For each identified REU program, determine the official application deadline and confirm eligibility criteria (e.g., student level, citizenship, academic requirements) using the NSF website or the program's official website. Document the source of each piece of information.
Identify and eliminate duplicate REU opportunities from the initial list. Prioritize opportunities based on the clarity and authority of the source information.

For the remaining opportunities, evaluate the degree to which the research aligns with AI and machine learning, justifying the inclusion or exclusion of each program based on its stated research focus.
